class.name: AbilityAsync
class.brief_description: A wait on an [AbilitySystemComponent] from outside any ability - a HUD, a quest, a door. Unreal's UAbilityAsync.
class.description: An [AbilityTask] belongs to an ability and dies with it. An AbilityAsync belongs to the component it watches, its target: the target keeps it alive, so nothing has to hold a variable for it. It ends when the target is freed, when the optional owner node leaves the tree or is freed, when [method end_action] is called, or - with [code]only_trigger_once[/code] - after it first triggers. Ended, it never triggers again, and a coroutine awaiting [signal triggered] is released without resuming. [codeblock] # A health bar: every change, for as long as the bar is in the tree. AbilityAsync.wait_attribute_change(asc, &"health", self).triggered.connect(_on_health_changed) # Once, awaited. await AbilityAsync.wait_gameplay_tag_removed(asc, &"State.Stunned", self, true).triggered [/codeblock] Something already true when it starts - a tag already owned - is delivered at the end of the frame, after the caller has connected. On a replicated client it hears the server's state as it arrives, which is what a client's HUD needs. To write your own, extend it, connect to [method get_ability_system_component] in [method _activate], call [method broadcast] when the thing happens, disconnect in [method _on_end], and start it with [method activate].

method.name: _activate
method.description: Called once from [method activate], with the target set. Connect to the target here.

method.name: _on_end
method.description: Called once when the async ends, for whatever reason - the target is still there if it is being freed. Disconnect from it here.

method.name: activate
method.description: Starts watching [param target]. [param owner], when given, ends the async when it leaves the tree. With [param only_trigger_once], the async ends after its first trigger. Returns itself, to chain.

method.name: broadcast
method.description: Reports that the thing waited for happened: emits [signal triggered] with [param result] at once when something is connected, otherwise at the end of the frame. With only_trigger_once, it ends the async.

method.name: end_action
method.description: Ends the async for good: no further triggers, every connection to [signal triggered] dropped - a coroutine awaiting it is released without resuming - and the target lets go of it.

method.name: get_ability_system_component
method.description: The target, or [code]null[/code] once it has been freed.

method.name: get_only_trigger_once
method.description: Whether the async ends after its first trigger.

method.name: get_owner_node
method.description: The owner node given to [method activate], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_ended
method.description: Whether the async has ended - by [method end_action], its owner, its target, or a single trigger.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Whether it has started and not ended.

method.name: wait_attribute_change
method.description: Triggers on every change to [param attribute]'s current value on [param target], with [code]{ old_value, new_value }[/code].

method.name: wait_gameplay_effect_applied
method.description: Triggers when an effect is applied to [param target] - every effect, or only those whose [member GameplayEffect.effect_tags] match [param effect_tag] - with [code]{ effect, active_id }[/code].

method.name: wait_gameplay_event
method.description: Triggers on a gameplay event with exactly [param event_tag] sent to [param target], with its payload.

method.name: wait_gameplay_tag_added
method.description: Triggers when [param target] comes to own [param tag] or a tag under it, and at once (at the end of the frame) if it already does. A second source granting the same tag is not a new arrival.

method.name: wait_gameplay_tag_removed
method.description: Triggers when [param target] stops owning [param tag] and every tag under it, and at once (at the end of the frame) if it owns none.

signal.name: triggered
signal.description: The thing waited for happened. [param result] depends on the wait.
